The main takeaway from our work is that

the inclusion of Pomerson loops leads to the emergence of a new scaling regime in the QCD analysis of DIS data at very high energy, where the scaling variable is the ratio between the momentum transfer and the proton saturation momentum, rather than the ratio between the latter and the energy of the incoming proton.
